tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides a game-theoretic attribution of how each feature contributes to the prediction, including the marginal impact of marital-status. Sensitivity analysis directly evaluates the prediction change when the feature is ablated (masked), which is the exact scenario of interest. These tools together offer both interpretability and empirical validation of the masking effect on the model's output in tabular data.
